mcqs.question: SWaDeS, associated with DRDO Defence Laboratory Jodhpur, is which of the following?
options: A portable Sea Water Desalination System
India’s first indigenous universal multi-calibre rocket launcher
A Depot Integration Management Edition logistics platform
mcqs.explanation: SWaDeS is a portable Sea Water Desalination System associated with DRDO Defence Laboratory Jodhpur. The universal multi-calibre rocket launcher is Suryastra, while the D4 Counter-Drone System and DIME are separate defence developments.
